author: Fixture Reporter
content:
Nvidia and Anthropic have moved discussions of a possible anchor investment into due diligence. Nvidia has received access to a data room containing financial records and offering materials for the proposed IPO.

The potential investment remains capped at $10 billion. Anthropic continues to target a raise of up to $100 billion at roughly a $2 trillion valuation, with an offering expected before the November U.S. midterm elections.

No investment agreement has been signed. The due-diligence step follows the preliminary talks reported earlier and does not mean the transaction has closed.
headline: Nvidia And Anthropic Move Proposed IPO Investment Talks Into Due Diligence
summary: Nvidia has begun reviewing Anthropic's financial records for a potential IPO investment of up to $10 billion; the proposed commitment remains unsigned.
